Ceol Rince na hÉireann tune index

A searchable, unofficial index of all 1207 tunes in Breandán Breathnach’s Ceol Rince na hÉireann volumes 1–5 — the landmark collection of Irish dance music gathered from traditional players. Search by any of the Irish or English titles the books give, filter by volume, and sort by book order to browse each volume by tune number.

945 tunes link to their closest match on thesession.org; sheet music and playback use that setting, so details may differ from the book. Most of the rest have Bill Black’s transcription from the Irish Traditional Tune Library.
